note: every entry: [E(level) - E(PBE0)] of the configuration minus that of S_pair (the P0 pair in the P0 field), plain differences, no E_int/2. T: single site (P4 pair in the P0 field); N: every atom at P4 with the P4 field. Added 21 Oct 2026 (embed.py POINT_CONFIGS): R: the P4r pair in the P0 field; NR: every atom at P4r with the P4r field, the in-field counterpart of pair.json corr at P4r; VS / VR: the vcS / vcP4r pairs in their relaxed cells with the X-ray-cell P0 / P4r charges, counterparts of pair.json corr at vcS / vcP4r; VR_minus_VS: the relaxed-cell correction difference.

configs_note.R: the P4r pair (aligned on P0) in the P0 environment with the P0 charges: single site at P4r, as T at P4
configs_note.NR: every atom at P4r (aligned on P0), the N composition, the P4r charges: the P4r pair in its own field, as N at P4 (its pair geometry is pair.json P4r)
configs_note.VS: every atom at vcS in the relaxed S lattice (own Ewald sum), the P0 charges fitted in the X-ray cell: the vcS pair in its own field (its pair geometry is pair.json vcS)
configs_note.VR: every atom at vcP4r in the relaxed P4r lattice (own Ewald sum), the N composition, the P4r charges fitted in the X-ray cell: the vcP4r pair in its own field (its pair geometry is pair.json vcP4r)
